overview: Social Mart is a mobile-first social commerce app combining the best of Instagram and TikTok. Users can share posts, interact with a community, showcase products, and explore a marketplace — all in one sleek, minimalist app.
features: User authentication with login and registration
Scrollable social feed with likes, comments, and saves
User profiles with followers, bio, and post grid
Image upload with caption for new posts
Bottom navigation bar for smooth mobile navigation
